visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a modern office interior with a group of approximately seven people gathered around a large grey table. A hand with a black wristband reaches into the frame from the bottom, pointing toward the group who are all smiling. In the background, a shelf is stocked with numerous snack bags and boxes, and a wall sign reads 'DON'T JUST DREAM IT'. (2) A man with short brown hair wearing a grey t-shirt, Ian, speaks energetically into the camera, gesturing with his hands. To his right, a woman in a white tank top, Mandy, smiles and watches him. The wall behind them features a large 'THE DODO MEN' logo and a vase of dried flowers. (3) The camera pans to show other office members. A woman with long dark hair in a white long-sleeved blouse holds a laptop and laughs. Behind her, a man in a white t-shirt and glasses stands near a desk. The lighting is bright and professional throughout the room. (4) Ian holds up three large, colorful boxes of Viva brand nuts to the camera. He rotates the boxes to show different product lines, including a yellow box and a pink box. His facial expression is one of high excitement, with a wide smile and enthusiastic hand movements. (5) Multiple people are shown in quick-cut sequences holding small yellow nut packets. They are pretending to type on their laptops or work while pouring the nuts directly into their mouths from the packets. Their expressions are joyful and they appear to be sharing a lighthearted moment. (6) In the final scene, Ian stands centrally, holding several boxes of nuts and gesturing toward the camera with a confident, inviting expression. The background remains the office shelf area, now prominently showcasing the endorsed snack products in various sizes and flavors.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat begins. A male voice asks '最喜歡哪個台灣的節慶?' with a bright, energetic tone and high arousal. Multiple female voices respond in the background with 'Taiwan' and laughter, creating a noisy, social atmosphere. (2) The male voice continues, shifting to a more narrative, professional tone as he discusses Thanksgiving. He emphasizes the word '烤雞' with a dramatic pitch rise and a slight pause for comedic effect. Faint laughter from the group is heard in the background noise floor. (3) A female voice takes the lead, speaking with a friendly and animated tone about the 'Zhongyuan Festival.' Her speech rate is moderate, and her pitch is slightly higher than the male's. The background music maintains a constant, energetic presence without ducking. (4) Distinct sounds of plastic rustling and crinkling are heard as multiple people open snack packets. There are audible percussive crunching sounds from people chewing. The male voice returns, listing specific product names with a very clear, enunciated articulation and authoritative tone. (5) The group voices overlap as they shout '飲料!' and '泡麵!' in unison, indicating high agreement. The male voice then explains the health benefits of nuts, using a persuasive, high-dominance tone. The BGM remains steady with a consistent synth texture and active rhythm. (6) The male voice concludes with a fast-paced call to action, mentioning retail store names like 'PxMart' and 'Carrefour'. His voice has high positive valence and excitement. A collective cheer from the group marks the end of the master track before the audio fades out.
